items.title: 'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race

items.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
items.summary: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.
